top_signals.title: Moving Down in High-Grade Quality: Goldman's Lynam
top_signals.summary:
Amanda Lynam, chief credit strategist at Goldman Sachs, and Winnie Cisar, global head of credit strategy at CreditSights, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US investment-grade bond sales set an annual record as a surge in artificial intelligence spending drives companies to borrow hundreds of billions of dollars.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Coinbase Returns to Profitability While Posting Another Revenue Drop
top_signals.summary: Coinbase Global Inc. returned to profitability for the first time in a year while posting a quarterly decline in revenue, showing how closely the largest US digital-asset platform’s fortunes remain wedded to crypto markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Need to Position Against AI Concentration Risk, Said D.J. Tierney
top_signals.summary: D.J. Tierney, senior investment portfolio strategist at Schwab Asset Management, said that 'we don't know' when the party is over for the AI trade and that Schwab is advising investors to start making changes at the margins to position themselves to insure against concentration risk.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
